vendorEvaluation.title: ITMAP Vendor Evaluation
vendorEvaluation.description: Interactive execution-vs-product maps position every vendor in your market. Drill into score rationale, compare historical movement and identify leaders vs challengers at a glance.

productEvaluation.title: Product Evaluation
productEvaluation.description: Side-by-side feature support matrices across hundreds of capabilities. See which vendors deliver the features you care about and where gaps exist.

ecosystemEvaluation.title: Ecosystem Evaluation
ecosystemEvaluation.description: Map partner networks, integrations and alliances to understand the full competitive landscape beyond product checklists.

conversationPlatform.title: Conversation Platform
conversationPlatform.description: Ask natural-language questions about any market or vendor. Our AI analyst synthesises scores, news, features and reports into sourced answers.

securityIntelligence.title: Security Intelligence
securityIntelligence.description: Monitor CVEs, CISA KEV alerts and EPSS exploit scores for the vendors in your stack. Get early warning when a supplier's security posture changes.

createRfps.title: Create RFPs
createRfps.description: Generate vendor-agnostic RFPs from any market's feature set, then run structured evaluations and shortlists in one workflow.

freePromise.title: No paywalls. No upsells. No fine print.
freePromise.description: ITMAP is free for technology buyers because our mission is to make enterprise IT selection transparent. We will never charge buyers for access to vendor intelligence, evaluations or RFP tools.

registration.title: Start evaluating for free today
registration.description: Registration is free and access is free — today and always. Create your buyer account with any email address and unlock every feature.
